recent.text: “I thought they were both great. I played with (Jones) in New York a lot, and I know how good of a hockey player he is, and he put it on display tonight. And (McCartney) was great too.” -Trocheck on Jones and McCartney making their Utah debuts

recent.text: “We've been getting better every night throughout the course of the year...we stuck to our plan the whole game and didn't get away from it. Played hard in the D zone. (Tourigny) always talks about pace, and I thought our pace was great.” -Vincent Trocheck on UTA defensive effort

recent.text: The Mammoth are now on a four game losing skid. However, while no loss should be celebrated, Thursday’s 65 minute and eight round shootout loss to the Blues is the closest it gets to that. #TusksUp https://t.co/rFv3bnHTZI
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Both Liam O’Brien and Ben McCartney saw very limited ice time tonight. Tourigny said it was a coach's decision rather than injury-related, but it wasn't because they did anything wrong. It was about the momentum and not wanting to put someone in cold. #TusksUp
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: POSTGAME "If I could talk about all our players that I liked tonight, we’d be here for a while... It’s the leaders who bought in and everybody else bought in. And that’s why they play(ed) that hard." @utahmammoth André Tourigny on the team's leadership group https://t.co/rjxoehLsyq
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR
